description:
Certificate of Lawful Development Proposed: Single storey rear extension following part demolition of existing extension. Alterations and extension to roof to form end gable; extension of
rear dormer.
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed existing building, by reason of the unlawful subdivision of the existing side garage as a separate self-contained residential flat at No. 6a Camrose Avenue which would be in breach of the Planning Enforcement notice ENF/0281/08/P dated 29th January 2010, the existing building on site would have more than a single residential unit which would not fall within the definition of “a dwellinghouse” and would not be considered as a single planning unit. The extent of demolition works which has removed the existing original roof would fall outside the scope of the criteria set out in Classes A, B and C, Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended). Therefore, the application site would not benefit from any permitted development rights as stipulated in Part 1, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).&nbsp; Furthermore, the proposed development would also fall foul of Article 3(5)(b) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) as part of the existing use of the application site would be unlawful use. The proposal is therefore not lawful development.&nbsp;</p>
